name: 洪荒世界
group_note: NT/nitan/Lonely lineage, sibling of nitan170911 (byte-identical master.c/dbase.c) -- ported nitan170911's full §15 dbase-architecture fix series in an earlier native-boot pass. This WASM pass found and fixed the real root cause of that earlier pass's unresolved 'update command returns default fail message' open item: adm/daemons/named.lpc's create() called an unguarded restore() on its own corrupted ~168KB save file (Illegal mapping format), throwing uncaught -- on this driver an uncaught create() error leaves the object permanently non-resident, and a later implicit NAME_D->invalid_new_name(...) call-string invocation on the still-unloaded object silently does nothing at all (no error, no retry) instead of auto-compiling it. Since get_char() (character creation) calls that function before ever reaching make_body()/enter_world(), EVERY new character creation silently died there -- no crash, no visible error -- leaving the connection wedged with no command path ever set, so every subsequent command (not just wizard commands) hit the generic 'what?' fail message forever. This affected ALL players, not just the admin account; the earlier native pass's diagnosis (a command-search-path gap specific to wizard verbs) was incomplete, understandably so since write()-based debugging couldn't distinguish 'call silently no-ops' from 'verb not found'. Fixed with the standard §7.41 corrupted-save-data guard: catch(restore()) in named.lpc's create(). Found via write()-based bisection through get_char() (log_file() doesn't persist across separate WASM invocations, so had to use write() in the real interactive input_to context instead). Also upgraded the wizlist entry from fluffos (admin) to fluffos (boss) -- this lineage's wiz_levels ranks (boss) above (admin) as the actual top tier, confirmed present in securityd.lpc's trusted_read/trusted_write['/']. Verified: full registration -> look/score -> fluffos routed to wizard rest room (巫师休息室) confirming (boss) status recognized -> update succeeds. LPC formatter run across all 24177 files; reverted 5 files with confirmed CJK re-spacing corruption found via a same-text-despaced-matches-old-file scan across 287 formatter-touched files; also directly diff-reviewed all 6 map.lpc ASCII-art zone-map files (box-drawing art doesn't match the CJK regex) -- all 6 clean, only cosmetic reformatting. Post-formatter re-verified clean.
